summary: Frontend testing of DrON Topografía dashboard with dynamic progression metrics. Tested login, dashboard KPIs, dynamic metrics based on project type (Pilas vs Excavación), GanttChart badges, Avances Semanales modal, and project deletion. Note: 'Programa Tabla' project was deleted in a previous session - only 3 projects remain.
action_items: Consider re-creating 'Programa Tabla' project with tipos=['pilas', 'anclas'] and pilas_planeadas=576 for complete testing
critical_code_review_comments: GanttChart.jsx correctly implements priority logic: pilas > muros > anclas > excavacion
DashboardView.jsx conditionally shows 'Volumen Excavado vs Planeado' only when volumenPlaneado > 0
AvancesSemanalesModal.jsx dynamically shows chart title and units based on actividades_tipo
Delete functionality uses window.confirm - works correctly but could use custom modal for better UX
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only 3 projects exist: Acuarela (excavation type, 50000m³ planeado), Torre Mezquitan, Hotel Marriott Centro. 'Programa Tabla' was deleted. To test pilas/anclas metrics, need to create a new project with actividades_tipo=['pilas', 'anclas'].

login_admin.details: Admin login with admin@dron.mx / admin123 works correctly

dashboard_kpis.details: 4 KPI cards displayed: Total Proyectos (3), Vuelos Realizados (0), Avance Promedio (33.3%), Vol. Excavación Total (50,000 m³)

acuarela_excavation_metrics.details: Acuarela project shows 'Progresión de Excavación' badge (orange), 'Volumen Excavado vs Planeado' section with 50,000 m³ planeado

gantt_chart_dynamic_badge.details: GanttChart shows correct badge color and icon based on project type (Excavación=orange/shovel)

avances_semanales_dynamic_chart.details: AvancesSemanalesModal shows 'Progresión de Excavación' chart with m³ units and Meta: 50,000 m³

project_deletion.details: Delete button triggers window.confirm dialog. 'Programa Tabla' was successfully deleted (only 3 projects remain)

conditional_volume_section.details: Dashboard correctly shows/hides 'Volumen Excavado vs Planeado' based on project's volumen_total_planeado

notes: The 'Programa Tabla' project mentioned in the test request was already deleted before this testing session. The dynamic metrics feature was verified using 'Acuarela' project which has excavation data. To fully test pilas/muros/anclas metrics, a new project with those activity types needs to be created.
